source_location: Original Japanese article pp 272-277; Tables 1-3 and experimental sections 2.1-2.5.
limitations: Original publisher PDF methods and Tables 1-3 visually reviewed. NMA-4 LOI conflicts (21.4 table versus 21.5 prose) and remains held. DTA endotherm/exotherm peaks are not DTG maxima. conditions_locator: Section 2.5, p 273: nitrogen 30 mL/min, 100 C prehold for 20 min, then 10 or 20 C/min to 600 C; approximate 7 mg fabric aliquots.

title: Pad-Steam Treatments of Cotton Fabrics with Vinyl Phosphonate Oligomers and/or N-Methylolacrylamide and Thermal Behavior of the Treated Fabrics

treatment_chemistry: Fyrol 76 vinyl phosphonate oligomer (FYR) and/or N-methylolacrylamide (NMA), ammonium persulfate initiated
treatment_method: Base fabric cleaned using 0.2% anionic surfactant, then ethanol/benzene (1:1) Soxhlet extraction and air drying. Pad with aqueous FYR/NMA bath and ammonium persulfate at 10% of monomer weight; approximately 80% pickup. Air dry, steam at 100 C for 10 min, air dry, wash in distilled water at 80 C for 30 min, vacuum dry and store over silica gel.

source_title: Performance of flame retardancy silk modified with water-soluble vinyl phosphoamide
source_location: Original final article pp 2336-2340, Table I, Table II, Figure 4 caption and preparation.
limitations: Original final-PDF indexed text for preparation, methods, thermal/LOI tables, figure caption and conclusions reviewed. PDF byte requests failed and pixel QA is unavailable. Table II residues are separate 600 C/10 min incineration results, not TG. Table I Td is at 11% loss, not T5/T10 or generic onset, so omitted from clean TG fields. FR first DTG peak is modifier decomposition and second peak is silk decomposition. A physical-property paragraph says 21.22% weight gain versus 24.22% in Table II/IV and Figure 4; normalized add-on is withheld and no alias is inferred. DMMEP columns are earlier-paper comparison, not new paired states.
LOI_locator: Table II, p 2339: DMMEPN P-N columns, control and 100% monomer-on-fabric states.
LOI_method: ASTM D 2863; Fire Testing Technology oxygen index instrument
TG_locator: Table I, p 2338, explicitly thermal analysis from Figure 4: DTG peaks and TG residue at 600 C.
conditions_locator: Characterization pp 2336-2337: nitrogen 100 mL/min, 10 C/min, 40-600 C; LOI method.
pairing_evidence: Figure 4 and thermal-results prose explicitly identify FR silk as the 24.22% weight-gain DMMEPN specimen. Table II maps that same weight gain to the 100% DMMEPN recipe and LOI 32.38. Control is the same degummed/bleached woven silk. Other loadings and durability-washed states lack matched TG.

treatment_method: 1 g silk with 1 g DMMEPN, 0.03 g KPS and 30 mL water at pH 3.5; oscillating bath at 90 C for 60 min. Soxhlet methanol extraction for 3 h, water rinse and room-temperature vacuum drying to constant mass.

treatment_method: Original kombucha BC was washed, bleached and swollen according to cited protocols; upstream recipe is not repeated. Dissolve 50 wt% anchovy powder relative to BC in distilled water at BC:liquid 1:10 w/v. Add citric acid at 10% w/v and sodium hypophosphite at crosslinker:catalyst molar ratio 1:1. Stir at 25 +/-2 C for 30 min, adjust to pH 10.0 +/-0.5 with 1 N NaOH, and denature at 80 C for 20 min with shaking at 80 rpm. Cool to 25 +/-2 C; immerse BC, ultrasonicate at 25 C for 30 min, shake at 30 C for 1 h at 80 rpm, cure at 160 C for 5 min and dry at 25 C for 24 h.
